title: The takeoff roll
summary: Flaps, brakes, thrust, and a hundred and thirty knots down the centreline in a gusting crosswind.
briefing: Runway nine right at Philadelphia, and a gusty wind across it. Today we only roll: no flying yet.
The rudder pedals steer: Z and X, or the right stick on a gamepad. Small, early corrections keep you on the centreline.

tasks.say: Flaps ten first: F, or the lever on the pedestal.

tasks.goal: Thrust levers forward to takeoff thrust.
tasks.say: Now the thrust levers, all the way forward: the equals key, or Shift and equals to push them straight up. Feel her start to roll.

tasks.goal: Accelerate to 130 kt on the centreline.
tasks.say: Keep the nose on the centreline with the rudder all the way to a hundred and thirty knots. The rudder works better as the speed builds.
tasks.done: A hundred and thirty. That's as far as we go today.

cues.say: You're drifting: a little rudder back to the centreline.

debrief.three: Right down the middle, gusts and all. You're ready to rotate.
debrief.two: Safely on the runway, if a little wandering. Earlier, smaller rudder.
debrief.one: We stayed on the concrete. Next time catch the drift before it grows.
debrief.failed: We left the centreline too far. The trick is small rudder, early. Again?
